pair_adjudications.reason: Both use SessionVariables, but one checks edit/revert/redo transitions and branching while the other checks the 50-edit bound and script-value/type preservation.

evidence.left_purpose: posting session undo redo SessionVariables starts with empty values. set(name,value) records an edit; revert(name) removes an override and returns True, or False if absent. undo()/redo() return the affected name, restoring prior override presence/value, or None when unavailable. A new editor edit clears redo. values is publicly readable; avoid private history inspection.
evidence.right_purpose: posting session history limit SessionVariables retains the latest 50 editor edits. Direct script writes to values do not add history; a later editor edit snapshots that script value, including non-string types. Undoing all retained edits stops at the retained boundary. Use public set/undo/values only.

pair_adjudications.reason: Freshness computes an age predicate with controlled time; routing uses that collaborator to choose cache/network/fallback. Shared component family is intentional and stays in train.

evidence.left_purpose: tldr python client cache freshness have_recent_cache(command,platform,language) is true for an existing cache with age in hours <= MAX_CACHE_AGE, and false for an older or missing file. Control tldr.datetime.now(), MAX_CACHE_AGE and the cache path; use local-naive datetime consistently and no sleeps.
evidence.right_purpose: tldr python client cache network routing get_page_for_platform(command,platform,remote,language,only_use_cache=False,system_cache=False) returns byte lines. With USE_CACHE=True a fresh cache avoids network. Otherwise a successful urlopen download uses timeout=10 and is cached; a failed download falls back to an available stale cache. A cache-only miss raises CacheNotExist without networking; a failed download with no cached page propagates the download error. Patch urlopen, cache readers/writers and freshness; do not contact a real server.
